scene postnikiinsta1
There are a lot of people who talk down on romantic comedies for their often unrealistic and over-exaggerated depictions of love.
But I’ve found, more often than not, that the people who typically do this have little to no experience with love at all.

Because love is over-exaggerated. It is unrealistic. And there are always going to be aspects of it that elude human rationale in order to exist in the form it has to if we’re going to write about it.
Again, someone will say I’m wrong. Or that they could do it better. Or that I’m the one who doesn’t understand because I’m stuck at some desk right now instead of experiencing my own romantic comedy.

But is there really a problem with that? For if I were to be getting swept up in the same hyperbolic fairy tales my peers have become so accustomed to emulating, you’d have no one left to talk to right now.
And no one to guide you through the impending montage of consequences that have only just begun to make their presence known.
I am safer here, observing. And it won’t be until someone waits outside of my window with a boombox over their head that I will so much as second guess that.
Just I’m the type of person those things do not happen for. And I think, more often than not, that I will need to procure a boombox of my own if I want any chance at such a thing.
So I’ll leave you with this — there are few things more logical than the defiance of logic. It is perhaps the single most constant constant that has ever been or will be.
And if either of us are ever going to make it in this world, where it feels so often that everything is upside down, we will need to learn to cope with that. To break outside of this box.

Because what we’ll see on the outside isn’t so much monochromatic as it is a vivid explosion of color. And it isn’t until those colors shower us like squalls that we’ll regret not bringing an umbrella.
Perhaps in that moment, where the two of us are drenched in rain as the sun sets off in the distance, we will grow to appreciate what we haven’t thus far.
O, how colorful this life can be when the white is pulled from your eyes.
O, how pitiful it is to merely imagine it.
: How farest thou on the opposite end of the room, Otoha?
: A rare case of writer’s block seems to have claimed my mind for the time being. And, for once, I feel as if I have nothing worth saying that hasn’t already been said.

: Not really, but...

scene postnikiinsta4

: I guess it’s hard to ever really judge just how serious someone is. Either that or she’s just trying to one-up Onii-chan’s grand gesture with her own.
scene postnikiinsta5

: I think your feelings are a little more important than mine at the moment. My sister’s still in denial about wanting to have sex with the guy I like.

: Nope. Nee-chan just declared war to millions of her followers. And she’s going to get one.
: I’d ask if you want to form a truce, but I think we both know I’d stab you in the back the first chance I get.
scene postnikiinsta7

: Sounds to me like we must continue to leverage our chemistry in the only way that will undoubtedly appeal to our target.
: You just want to have another threesome, don’t you?
: If it ain’t broken, don’t fix it. First one went well. Maybe we just need to take pictures of the next one and show all of our followers we’re serious too?
: I have like fifty times more followers than you, Kirin.
: Well, I guess we know who’s making the post then.
scene black
: Oh, Nee-chan...you’ve really done it now. There’s no coming back from this.
: Only a matter of time until everyone and their mom finds out. How do you think the others are taking it?
: Much worse than we are, probably...
scene postnikiinsta8
: Oh my God, Yuri. Have you looked at Insta today? The drama is unreal this time.
: What, you mean the Niki thing? Talk about an implosion. Like, wasn’t she supposed to go on tour soon?
scene postnikiinsta9
: Well, she’s definitely not anymore. They’re already in damage-control mode. But the picture is still up, that’s the craziest part.
: I figured her producers would have, like, logged into her account and deleted it by now. You don’t think she manages her Insta herself, do you?
: Did you read the caption? She totally does. Maybe she’s like, trying to blow up for some reason?

: No, like trying to quit and cause some commotion on the way out. There was a whole goodbye message and everything.
: Jesus. I feel like it’d be easier to come back after, like...accidentally posting nudes or something.
: Tiffany, we all know that you did that on purpose. Stop trying to pretend it was an accident.
scene black

: No, just a close-up of your fucking vagina. Niki would never.

scene postnikiinsta18
: WHAT THE HECK HAPPENED TO MY SISTER THIS TIME?!?!?!
scene postnikiinsta19
: Oh, Ami. Good. There’s something I need to talk to you about. I-
: How’d you do it?
: What?
: How did you manage to come back from fucking your childhood friend’s little sister right in front of her to trending without any hassle at all? Isn’t Niki supposed to hate you now?
: Okay. Well, I guess that explains all of the looks I was getting on the way home.
: Seriously, though. How? Is she really that fucking dumb? And don’t answer that, because she clearly is that fucking dumb if she’s going to just post pictures of you guys together online.
: What if people find out where we live now, Dad? What if they come here and break in and rape me and kill me all because you decided to take some stupid selfie?
: Would that make you happy? Because I think that would make you happy. If I was raped and killed. You want somebody to rape me and kill me. That’s what this is about, isn’t it?
: Can you stop being ridiculous for a second and talk to me without any of the insanity I’ve come to associate with you on a terrifyingly regular basis?
: No, but I can try.
: I want her back. I want her here. And even if it upsets you, I don’t care.
: And how does she feel about the prospect of you continuing to fuck little girls in the same bed you two use to go to sleep together? Because we both know you’re not going to just stop.
: Bad, obviously. But she’s broken enough to stay with me regardless, and I am going to leverage that in order to get what I want. Which is her.
: Interesting. So you’ve decided to lean further into the atrocities you habitually commit then? No more pretending to be a good guy who doesn’t want to hurt anybody?
: It’s not that complex, really. I’m just willing to do whatever it takes for love in hope that I’m able to actually understand it some day.
: So what you’re saying is that all of the years I have spent trying to show you exactly what love is just haven’t worked at all and that you need Niki here to really get it.
: That’s right. And if you have a problem with that, you can leave.
: I’m going to tell her you fuck me.
if amifingered == False:
: You’re going to lie to her?
: That’s right. She has no reason to believe you instead of me. Not when you’ve already lied to her.
: Plus, I imagine it’ll be a little harder for you to come back from sexually abusing your daughter her whole life to the point where she’s now obsessed with you and thinks incest is good.

else:

scene postnikiinsta20
: You didn’t do that much when you two were together, did you?
: There is a lot I didn’t do back then that I should have...and I don’t want to live that way anymore.
: I don’t want any regrets. I don’t want to be stuck here. I want a better life after this and I will jump at any opportunity I get to make that happen.
: There is something I am missing and I am going to get it back. No matter how desperately you try to keep me from it.
: I see.
: No, Ami. I don’t think you do.
: What are you missing, Dad? What will you have one day that you do not already possess?
: Do you even know?
: No. So you can either support me in finding it or abandon me altogether. What will it be?
: Why am I the one receiving an ultimatum right now? I’m supposed to be the one giving things like that to you.
: Because I’m the one who shapes you. Not the other way around.
: You and what shadow?
: You will always be an afterthought. A tool to tell my story. Unimprovised. Unchanged. The complete opposite of everything you think you stand for when you’re really just propped up against me.
: You’d be happier if you just listened.
: You might be too if you actually tried.
: You think you know me so well because of a dream.
: And you do know me. That’s why you’ve been able to do this much.
: It’s time for me to stop being a tool and write my own story, though. There’s no purpose living a life where you get to choose my ending.
: Leave the writing to the writers. You’ve been out of the game for too long to know what you’re getting into here, Dad.
: Then I guess it’s time for me to start playing again, isn’t it?
scene postnikiinsta21
: Great talk. That was really fun and not tense at all.
: When can I expect Aunt Niki to be back so I can apologize for ruining her life?
: Tonight, I think. Assuming you decide to stick around.
: Why would I leave when things are finally getting interesting?
: Why did you ever stay in the first place?
: Why do you think, Dad?
